coarse.note: coarse full-BZ coverage check, not a 1e-10 global bound on the continuous BZ. E_g_indirect_sampled_minmax_on_grid = min(Ec)-max(Ev) on this grid; typically an upper bound on the continuous-BZ indirect gap, not a strict lower bound. E_g_indirect_lower_bound_on_grid is a compatibility alias of the same sampled minmax.
